recognize_zh: 這張是腦部 MRI 顯影後軸切面：雙側視丘／基底核與左側顳枕葉可見多顆邊緣環狀增強、中心低訊號的病灶，屬多發性環狀增強病灶（ring-enhancing lesions），配合肝膿瘍培養出 Nocardia 支持 Nocardia 腦膿瘍。
features: Axial post-contrast T1-weighted (3D BRAVO) MRI of the brain
At least three to four ring-enhancing lesions: two adjacent lesions in the deep gray matter/thalami and one in the left temporo-occipital region near the lateral ventricle
Lesions show thin, smooth, complete rims of enhancement with central non-enhancing (hypointense) cores
Mild surrounding hypointensity suggestive of perilesional edema; no marked midline shift
Non-morphologic radiology image; imaging alone cannot establish the organism
describe_en: Axial contrast-enhanced T1-weighted MRI of the brain demonstrates multiple ring-enhancing lesions, including two in the deep gray matter near the thalami and one in the left posterior temporal/occipital region adjacent to the lateral ventricle. The lesions have thin, relatively smooth enhancing rims with central non-enhancing cores and mild surrounding edema, without significant mass effect or midline shift on this slice. Ring enhancement is nonspecific and encompasses abscess, toxoplasmosis, lymphoma and metastasis; diffusion-weighted imaging and microbiologic sampling are needed for specificity. In the context of Nocardia identified from a liver abscess, the findings are suggestive of disseminated nocardiosis with brain abscesses.

ddx.vs: Toxoplasma lesions favor the basal ganglia in profoundly immunosuppressed patients and may show an eccentric target sign, and are distinguished by serology, PCR and response to empiric therapy rather than imaging alone.

Lymphoma typically shows solid homogeneous enhancement with restricted diffusion of the solid component, periventricular location and CSF or biopsy evidence of clonal B cells, whereas abscess cavities show central restricted diffusion.
Metastases usually lie at the gray-white junction with thick irregular rims and disproportionate edema, and lack central diffusion restriction.
Angioinvasive fungal abscesses are often hemorrhagic with susceptibility artifact and vascular territory infarction; tissue culture separates them.
